questions.question: Simplify the following expression. \(3\frac{6}{7} - \left\{ {5\frac{1}{7} - \left( {2\frac{3}{7} - 3\overline {\frac{5}{7} - 4} } \right)} \right\}\)
questions.solution:
Given:

\(3\frac{6}{7} - \left\{ {5\frac{1}{7} - \left( {2\frac{3}{7} - 3\overline {\frac{5}{7} - 4} } \right)} \right\}\)

Calculation:

⇒ \(3\frac{6}{7} - \left\{ {5\frac{1}{7} - \left( {2\frac{3}{7} - 3\overline {\frac{5}{7} - 4} } \right)} \right\}=3\frac{6}{7} - \left\{ {5\frac{1}{7} - \left( {2\frac{3}{7} - \overline{\frac{26}{7} - 4} } \right)} \right\}\)

⇒ \(3\frac{6}{7} - \left\{ {5\frac{1}{7} - \left( {2\frac{3}{7} - {\frac{-2}{7}} } \right)} \right\}\)

⇒ \(3\frac{6}{7} - \left\{ {5\frac{1}{7} - \left( {\frac{17}{7} + {\frac{2}{7}} } \right)} \right\}=3\frac{6}{7} - \left\{ {5\frac{1}{7} - {\frac{19}{7} }} \right\}\)

⇒ \(\frac{27}{7}-\frac{36-19}{7}=\frac{27}{7}-\frac{17}{7}\)

⇒ \(\frac{27-17}{7}=\frac{10}{7}\)

Hence, the simplified value of the expression is \(\frac{10}{7}\)

Given:

Expression: (0.72 + (0.4 + 0.2) × 0.7 + 0.4 × 0.2) / (0.7 + 0.4)

Formula used:

Simplify the numerator first and then divide by the denominator.

Calculation:

Numerator: 0.72 + (0.4 + 0.2) × 0.7 + 0.4 × 0.2

= 0.49 + 0.6 × 0.7 + 0.08

= 0.49 + 0.42 + 0.08

= 0.99

Now, divide the numerator by the denominator:

0.99 / 1.1

= 0.9

∴ The simplified value of the expression is 0.9.

questions.question: If A = \(\frac{9}{16} \div \frac{25}{36}\) , B = 9 ÷ [(16 ÷ 25) ÷ 36], C = [9 ÷ (16 ÷ 25)] ÷ 36, D = (9 ÷ 16) ÷ (25 ÷ 36), then which of the following is true?
questions.questionHtml: If A = \(\frac{9}{16} \div \frac{25}{36}\), B = 9 ÷ [(16 ÷ 25) ÷ 36], C = [9 ÷ (16 ÷ 25)] ÷ 36, D = (9 ÷ 16) ÷ (25 ÷ 36), then which of the following is true?
questions.solution:
Given:

A = (9 / 16) ÷ (25 / 36)

B = 9 ÷ [(16 ÷ 25) ÷ 36]

C = [9 ÷ (16 ÷ 25)] ÷ 36

D = (9 ÷ 16) ÷ (25 ÷ 36)

Formula Used:

To divide fractions: (a / b) ÷ (c / d) = (a / b) × (d / c)

Calculation:

A:

A = (9 / 16) ÷ (25 / 36)

A = (9 / 16) × (36 / 25)

A = (9 × 36) / (16 × 25)

A = 324 / 400

A = 81 / 100

B:

B = 9 ÷ [(16 ÷ 25) ÷ 36]

Calculate inside the brackets first:

16 ÷ 25 = 0.64

0.64 ÷ 36 = 0.0177778

B = 9 ÷ 0.0177778

B = 506.25

C:

C = [9 ÷ (16 ÷ 25)] ÷ 36

Calculate inside the brackets first:

16 ÷ 25 = 0.64

9 ÷ 0.64 = 14.0625

C = 14.0625 ÷ 36

C = 0.390625

D:

D = (9 ÷ 16) ÷ (25 ÷ 36)

D = (9 / 16) × (36 / 25)

D = (9 × 36) / (16 × 25)

D = 324 / 400

D = 81 / 100

Conclusion:

A = D = 81 / 100

B = 506.25

C = 0.390625

A and D are equal. B and C are different. So A and D are true and equal, while B and C are not equal.

questions.question: If x 2a = y 2b = z 2c ≠ 0 and x 2 = yz, then the value of \(\frac{{ab + bc + ca}}{{bc}}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If x2a = y2b = z2c ≠ 0 and x2 = yz, then the value of \(\frac{{ab + bc + ca}}{{bc}}\) is:
questions.solution:
x2a = y2b = z2c ≠ 0

Let x2a = y2b = z2c = k, then

x = k1/2a, y = k1/2b, z = k1/2c

Now,

x2 = yz

x × x = y × z

k1/2a × k1/2a = k1/2b × k1/2c

k(1/2a + 1/2a) = k(1/2b + 1/2c)

Comparing on power

1/2a + 1/2a = 1/2b + 1/2c

⇒ 2/2a = (c + b)/2bc

⇒ 1/a = (c + b)/2bc

⇒ 2bc = ac + ab

Now,

\(\frac{{ab + bc + ca}}{{bc}}\)

⇒ (2bc + bc)/bc

⇒ 3bc/bc

⇒ 3

questions.question: The value of the expression 1800 ÷ 10{(18 - 6) + [-2(1 + 2 )]} is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Solve the nested terms from inside out: (1 + 2) = 3 and (18 − 6) = 12.

The middle term becomes [−2 × 3] = −6.

The brace term becomes {12 + (−6)} = 6.

The expression reduces to 1800 ÷ 10{6}, which is 1800 ÷ 60.

Calculation: 1800 ÷ 60 = 30.

∴ The correct option is C.

Alternate Method

Given expression: 1800 ÷ 10{(18 − 6) + [−2(1 + 2)]}

Formula: VBODMAS (Vinculum, Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 1800 ÷ 10{(12) + [−2(3)]}

⇒ 1800 ÷ 10{12 + (−6)}

⇒ 1800 ÷ 10{12 − 6}

⇒ 1800 ÷ 10{6}

⇒ 1800 ÷ (10 × 6)

⇒ 1800 ÷ 60

⇒ 30

∴ The correct option is C.

Additional Information

VBODMAS Rule

It defines the sequence for solving mathematical operations: Vinculum → Brackets → Of → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction.

Bracket Priority

Always solve in the order of: circular brackets ( ), then curly braces { }, and finally square brackets [ ].

Implicit Multiplication

In many competitive exams, a number adjacent to a bracket (juxtaposition) is treated as a priority operation, similar to the Of (O) step.

questions.question: If a 2 + b 2 + 2b + 4a + 5 = 0, then the value of \(\frac{{2a - 3b}}{{2a + 3b}}\) is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If a2 + b2 + 2b + 4a + 5 = 0, then the value of \(\frac{{2a - 3b}}{{2a + 3b}}\) is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given:

a2 + b2 + 2b + 4a + 5 = 0,

Formula used:

(a + b)2  = a2 + b2 + 2ab

Calculation:

a2 + b2 + 2b + 4a + 5 = 0,

⇒ a2 + 4a + b2 + 2b + 5 = 0

⇒ (a + 2)2 = a2 + 4a + 4

⇒ (b + 1)2 = b2 + 2b + 1

⇒ a2 + 4a + 4 + b2 + 2b + 1 = 0

⇒ (a + 2)2 + (b + 1)2 = 0

So, a + 2 = 0

⇒ a = -2

And, b + 1 = 0

⇒ b = -1

Then, \(\frac{{2a - 3b}}{{2a + 3b}}\)

Put the value of a and b in this equation

\(\Rightarrow \frac{{2 \ \times\ \left( { - 2} \right)\ -\ 3\ \times\ \left( { - 1} \right)}}{{2 \ \times \ \left( { - 2} \right)\ + \ 3 \ \times\ \left( { - 1} \right)}}\)

\(\Rightarrow \frac{{ - 4 \ +\ 3}}{{ - 4\ -\ 3}}\)

⇒ -1/-7 

⇒ 1/7

∴ The value of\(\frac{{2a - 3b}}{{2a + 3b}}\)  is  1/7

Step 2: Calculate the product:

Step 3: Add the results:

questions.question: The value of \(\rm \frac{(x-y)^3+(y-z)^3+(z-x)^3}{(x^2-y^2)^3+(y^2-z^2)^3+(z^2-x^2)^3}\) where x ≠ y ≠ z, is:
questions.questionHtml: The value of \(\rm \frac{(x-y)^3+(y-z)^3+(z-x)^3}{(x^2-y^2)^3+(y^2-z^2)^3+(z^2-x^2)^3}\) where x ≠ y ≠ z, is:
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\rm \frac{(x-y)^3+(y-z)^3+(z-x)^3}{(x^2-y^2)^3+(y^2-z^2)^3+(z^2-x^2)^3}\)

Concept Used:

(a2 - b2) = (a + b)(a – b)

Calculation:

⇒ From the given expression, consider the denominator

⇒ (x2 – y2)3 + (y2 – z2)3 + (z2 – x2)3

⇒ Consider (x2 – y2) = A, (y2 – z2) = B, (z2 – x2) = C

⇒ Let A + B + C = x2 – y2 + y2 – z2 + z2 – x2 = 0

⇒ If A + B + C = 0, then (A3 + B3 + C3) = 3ABC.

⇒ Therefore, denominator = 3(x2 – y2)(y2 – z2)(z2 – x2)

⇒ Similarly, numerator (x – y)3 + (y – z)3 + (z – x)3 = 3(x – y)(y – z)(z – x)

⇒ Therefore, \(\frac{Numerator}{Denominator}\) = \(\frac{3(x – y)(y – z)(z – x)}{3(x^2 – y^2)(y^2 – z^2)(z^2 – x^2)}\) = \(\frac{(x – y)(y – z)(z – x)}{(x^2 – y^2)(y^2 – z^2)(z^2 – x^2)}\) .............(1)

⇒ We know that, (a2 - b2) = (a + b)(a – b)

⇒ From the above formula equation (1) can be written as

⇒ \(\frac{(x – y)(y – z)(z – x)}{(x+y)(x-y)(y+z)(y-z)(z-x)(z+x)}\)= \(\frac{1}{(x+y)((y+z)(z+x)}\)

Therefore, the value of \(\rm \frac{(x-y)^3+(y-z)^3+(z-x)^3}{(x^2-y^2)^3+(y^2-z^2)^3+(z^2-x^2)^3}\) is \(\frac{1}{(x+y)((y+z)(z+x)}\).​

questions.question: What is the value of the following expression ? \(2^2 \left(\frac{x^a}{x^b}\right)^{(a+b)} × 3^2 \left(\frac{x^b}{x^c}\right)^{(b+c)} × 6^{-2} \left(\frac{x^c}{x^a}\right)^{(a+c)}\)
questions.questionHtml:
What is the value of the following expression ?

\(2^2 \left(\frac{x^a}{x^b}\right)^{(a+b)} × 3^2 \left(\frac{x^b}{x^c}\right)^{(b+c)} × 6^{-2} \left(\frac{x^c}{x^a}\right)^{(a+c)}\)
questions.solution:
\(2^2 \left(\frac{x^a}{x^b}\right)^{(a+b)} × 3^2 \left(\frac{x^b}{x^c}\right)^{(b+c)} × 6^{-2} \left(\frac{x^c}{x^a}\right)^{(a+c)}\)

⇒ \(2^2\left(x\right)^{(a-b)(a+b)}\times3^2\left(x\right)^{(b-c)(b+c)}\times6^{-2}\left(x\right)^{(c-a)(c+a)} \)  

⇒ \(2^2\left(x\right)^{(a^2-b^2)}\times3^2\left(x\right)^{(b^2-c^2)}\times(3\times2)^{-2}\left(x\right)^{(c^2-a^2)} \)

 ⇒ \(2^2\left(x\right)^{(a^2-b^2)}\times3^2\left(x\right)^{(b^2-c^2)}\times(3)^{-2}\times(2)^{-2}\left(x\right)^{(c^2-a^2)}\)

 ⇒ \(2^{(2+(-2))}\times 3^{(2+(-2)}\times x^{(a^{2}-b^{2})+(b^{2}-c^{2})+(c^{2}-a^{2})}\)

⇒ 20 × 30 × x0  ⇒ 1 × 1 × 1 = 1

questions.question: The value of \(7\frac{4}{13}\div\frac{5}{26}\) of \(\left(4\frac{3}{5}+7\frac{2}{5}\right) + \left(7\frac{1}{6}-2\frac{1}{3}\right)\) is:
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below.

Calculation:

\(7\frac{4}{13}\div\frac{5}{26}\) of \(\left(4\frac{3}{5}+7\frac{2}{5}\right) + \left(7\frac{1}{6}-2\frac{1}{3}\right)\) 

⇒ 95/13 ÷ 5/26 of (23/5 + 37/5) + (43/6 - 7/3)

⇒ 95/13 ÷ 5/26 of (60/5) + (29/6)

⇒ 95/13 ÷ 5/26 of 12 + 29/6 

⇒ 95/13 × 13/30 + 29/6 

⇒ 19/6 + 29/6 

⇒ 48/6 = 8 

∴ \(7\frac{4}{13}\div\frac{5}{26}\) of \(\left(4\frac{3}{5}+7\frac{2}{5}\right) + \left(7\frac{1}{6}-2\frac{1}{3}\right)\) = 8

questions.question: Simplify: \(\frac{{\frac{{27}}{{14}} \div \frac{{24}}{7}of\frac{{63}}{{28}} - \frac{9}{4}}}{{\frac{{35}}{8} \div \frac{{15}}{4}of\frac{7}{{48}} + \frac{5}{{16}}}} \div \frac{{196}}{{95}}\)
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\frac{{\frac{{27}}{{14}} \div \frac{{24}}{7}of\frac{{63}}{{28}} - \frac{9}{4}}}{{\frac{{35}}{8} \div \frac{{15}}{4}of\frac{7}{{48}} + \frac{5}{{16}}}} \div \frac{{196}}{{95}}\)

Concept used:

BODMAS

Calculations:

\(\frac{{\frac{{27}}{{14}} \div \frac{{24}}{7}of\frac{{63}}{{28}} - \frac{9}{4}}}{{\frac{{35}}{8} \div \frac{{15}}{4}of\frac{7}{{48}} + \frac{5}{{16}}}} \div \frac{{196}}{{95}}\)

= \(\frac{{\frac{{27}}{{14}} \div (\frac{{24}}{7}×\frac{{63}}{{28}}) - \frac{9}{4}}}{{\frac{{35}}{8} \div (\frac{{15}}{4}×\frac{7}{{48}}) + \frac{5}{{16}}}} \div \frac{{196}}{{95}}\)

= \(\frac{{\frac{{27}}{{14}} \div \frac{54}{7} - \frac{9}{4}}}{{\frac{{35}}{8} \div \frac{35}{64} + \frac{5}{{16}}}} ×\frac{{95}}{{196}}\)

=\(\frac{{\frac{{27}}{{14}} ×\frac{7}{54} - \frac{9}{4}}}{{\frac{{35}}{8} × \frac{64}{35} + \frac{5}{{16}}}} ×\frac{95}{196}\)

= \(\frac{\frac{1}{4}-\frac{9}{4}}{8+\frac{5}{16}}×\frac{95}{196}\)

= \(\frac{-2}{\frac{133}{16}}×\frac{95}{196}\)

= \(\frac{-40}{343}\)

\(\therefore\) The simplified value is \(\frac{-40}{343}\).

questions.question: \(\frac{6.75~\times ~6.75~\times ~6.75-4.25~\times ~4.25~\times ~4.25}{67.5~\times ~67.5~+~42.5~\times ~42.5~+~67.5~\times ~42.5}=?\)
questions.solution:
Mistake Points

In this type of question, in the numerator, there are 6.75 and 4.25, while in the denominator there is 67.5, and 42.5 is present in multiplication.

From the denominator, we can write 67.5 × 67.5 as 6.75 × 10 × 6.75 × 10 = 100 × (6.75), and similarly for other terms.

Therefore we take 100 as common from the denominator.

Identity used:

a3 - b3 = (a - b) (a2 + b2 + ab)

Calculation:

\(\Rightarrow \text{ }\!\!~\!\!\text{ }\frac{6.75~\times ~6.75~\times ~6.75-4.25~\times ~4.25~\times ~4.25}{67.5~\times ~67.5~+~42.5~\times ~42.5~+~67.5~\times ~42.5}\)

\( \Rightarrow {\rm{}}\frac{{\left[ {\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}}-{\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)} \right]}}{{[100{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)}}\)

⇒ ? = 2.5/100

⇒ ? = 0.025

∴ ? = 0.025

questions.question: Simplify: 2[8p + 5 {n - 2 \((n-\overline {n + p} )\) + 4p}]
questions.solution:
Given:

2[8p + 5 {n - 2 \((n-\overline {n + p} )\) + 4p}]

Concept Used:

BODMAS = Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction

Calculation:

⇒ 2[8p + 5 {n - 2 \((n-\overline {n + p} )\) + 4p}]

⇒ 2[8p + 5 {n - 2 \((n-{n - p} )\) + 4p}]

⇒ 2[8p + 5 {n + \(2p\) + 4p}] = \(2[8p+5n+30p]\)

⇒ \(16p+10n+60p=76p+10n\)

Hence, the value of the simplified expression is 76p + 10n

questions.question: The value of is: (427 × 427 × 427 + 325× 325 × 325)/(42.7 × 42.7 – 42.7 × 32.5 + 32.5 × 32.5)
questions.solution:
Given:

(427 ×  427 × 427 + 325× 325 × 325)/(42.7 × 42.7 –  42.7 × 32.5 + 32.5 × 32.5)

Formula used:

(a3 + b3) = (a + b)(a2 - ab + b2)

(a + b) =(a3+ b3)/(a2 - ab + b2)

Calculation:

(427 ×  427 × 427 + 325 × 325 × 325)/(42.7 × 42.7 + 42.7 × 32.5 – 32.5 × 32.5)

⇒ (4273 + 3253)/[(427/10)2+ (325/10)2 – (427/10 × 325/10)]

⇒ (4273 + 3253)/[(427)2 + (325)2 – (427 × 325)]/100

Let 427 and 325 be 'a' and 'b' respectively

⇒ [{(a3 + b3)/(a2 – ab + b2)}/100]

⇒ [(a + b) × (1/100)]

⇒ [(427 + 325) × 100]

⇒ 752 × 100 = 75200

∴ The value of equation is 75200.

questions.question: The value of 272 ÷ 16 + [119 ÷ {1491 ÷ 3 (21 – 13 × 8 + 4 × 3)}] is.
questions.solution:
Given:

272 ÷ 16 + [119 ÷ {1491 ÷ 3 (21 – 13 × 8 + 4 × 3)}]

Formula used:

Calculation:

First of all, we will solve brackets, and inside brackets, multiplication and addition are given, so we will prefer multiplication first.

So, 272 ÷ 16 + [119 ÷ {1491 ÷ 3 (21 – 13 × 8 + 4 × 3)}]

= 272 ÷ 16 + [119 ÷ {1491 ÷ 3 (21 – 104 + 12)}]

Now, we will solve the innermost bracket

= 272 ÷ 16 + [119 ÷ {1491 ÷ 3 (-71)}]

Now, We will open the innermost bracket, and hence, perform, multiplication.

= 272 ÷ 16 + [119 ÷ {1491 ÷ -213}]

Now, we will perform the division in the inner bracket.

= 272 ÷ 16 + [119 ÷ {-7}]

Now, we will perform the division in the inner bracket.

= 272 ÷ 16 + [-17]

Now, we will perform division,

= 17  -17

Further solving, we get 0.

12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of (5.6 - 3.8 × 1.03)]

Calculation:

12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of (5.6 - 3.8 × 1.03)]

⇒ 12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of (5.6 - 3.914)]

⇒ 12.3 - [7 + 0.8 of 1.686]

⇒ 12.3 - [7 + 1.3488]

⇒ 12.3 - 8.3488

⇒ 3.9512

∴ The correct answer is option (4).

questions.question: The value of \(\sqrt {9 - 2\sqrt {11 - 6\sqrt 2 } }\) is closest to:
questions.questionHtml: The value of \(\sqrt {9 - 2\sqrt {11 - 6\sqrt 2 } }\) is closest to:
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\sqrt{9 - 2\sqrt{11 - 6\sqrt 2}} \)

Formula used:

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

(a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

Calculation:

\(\sqrt{9 - 2\sqrt{11 - 6\sqrt 2}} \)

⇒ \(\sqrt{9-2\sqrt{{3^2}+{{\left({\sqrt2}\right)}^2}-2\times3\times\sqrt 2}}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{9-2\sqrt{{{\left({3-\sqrt2}\right)}^2}}}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt {9-2\left({3-\sqrt2}\right)}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{9-6+2\sqrt2}{\rm{\;}}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{3+2\sqrt2}\)

⇒ \(\sqrt{{{\left({\sqrt2}\right)}^2}+{\rm{\;}}{1^2}+2\sqrt2}\)

⇒ \({\sqrt{(\sqrt{2}+1})^2}\)

⇒ √2 + 1

⇒ 1.4 + 1 = 2.4

questions.question: The value of 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {4 × 3 – (9 – 11) ÷ (2 ÷ 4 of 4)}] is:
questions.questionHtml: The value of 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {4 × 3 – (9 – 11) ÷ (2 ÷ 4 of 4)}] is:
questions.solution:
Concept Used:          

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

Calculation:

8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {4 × 3 – (9 – 11) ÷ (2 ÷ 4 of 4)}]

⇒ 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {4 × 3 – (9 – 11) ÷ (2 ÷ 16)}]

⇒ 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {4 × 3 – (9 – 11) ÷ 1/8}]

⇒  8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {4 × 3 – (9 – 11) × 8}]

⇒ 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {4 × 3 – (-2) × 8}]

⇒ 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {4 × 3 + 2 × 8}]

⇒ 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of {12 + 16}]

⇒ 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 4 of 28]

⇒ 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – [56 ÷ 112]

⇒ 8 ÷ 2 of 3 – 1/2

⇒ 8 ÷ 6 – 1/2

⇒ 4/3 – 1/2

⇒ (8 – 3)/6

⇒ 5/6

∴ The required value is 5/6
